sections.section_title: GFXTIM absolute line counter compare 1 register (GFXTIM_ALCC1R)
sections.text_helper: Section 23.5.18 "GFXTIM absolute line counter compare 1 register (GFXTIM_ALCC1R)" in chapter 23 (Graphic timer (GFXTIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1111.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x070
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 LINE[11:0]: Line number
Compare value 1 for the absolute line counter.
